svg.text: GitHub token setup, layout B mockup (dark). Settings > GitHub gets a Connection block; banners link to it.
Round 2 of wireframe B. Tokens: tokens.md and density-tokens.md (comfortable). Real sizes: Settings dialog 880x640, list pane 420 at 1660, phone 412x915.
Scope list corrected from the code: only repo is required. read:org (team review requests) and project (issue Status, Move to In progress) are optional.
Check again re-runs gh auth token, swaps the token in memory, re-reads X-OAuth-Scopes and resyncs. No restart.

svg.text: Marks: filled tick = granted. Filled cross = required scope missing. Ringed cross = optional scope missing. Dashed ring with ? = unknown (no token).
Pills: Not connected (neutral, dashed), Sync paused (danger, alert icon), Partly on (attention), All on (success, tick). Word and shape carry state, not colour.
